summary: Opus review of the P0 diff: 0 Critical, 2 Important, 4 Minor (docs/plans/2026-10-26-P0-review.md). Fixed RED->GREEN: the runner now prints a hung file's output on TERM and names it; a file exiting non-zero with no FAIL line counts as one failed check; treekey drops absolute/.. ignore entries. verified_how: 3 new checks watched red (suite-runner 9/11, check-key 7/8), then green; suite-runner file 5x 11/11; full suite through lib/check.sh 395/395 in 208 s (slowest 15-run-4 157.5 s); SPLIT_OUT=tmp split.sh matches tests/checks 01-32 byte for byte; bash -n on 43 P0 shell files, node --check treekey/testcount.

discoveries.text: tests/run.sh now traps TERM/INT/HUP: a file still running when check.sh's timeout fires prints its output so far and '<file>: unfinished when the suite was stopped'. P2's TEST_FILE_TIMEOUT per file should reuse that line shape (one FAIL per hung file).

A check file that exits non-zero with no FAIL line now adds 'FAIL <file>: exited <rc> before its end, with no FAIL line' to the total, so a subset run can no longer read as all passed while a file crashed.
